8700: Cortech Endurance Slim ADA Wall Mount Desk
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-8700-endurance-ada-compliant-wall-mounted-slim-desk
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-slim-ada-desk/
Spec sheets: 8700, Installation
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Slim ADA Wall Mount Desk – 8700
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mounted Slim Desk ADA‑Compliant - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 8700
Subtitle: Space-Saving One-Piece Molded ADA-Compliant Desk for Corners or Standard Wall Mounting
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 8700 Endurance ADA Compliant Wall Mount Slim Desk
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Slim ADA Wall Mount Desk is a space-saving, ADA-compliant desk for compact cells, patient rooms, and other secure settings. It is designed to fit in a corner or on a standard wall.
The desk is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, with no steel or wood components. It bolts to the wall through pilot holes with hardware of your choice.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene; no steel or wood components
ADA Compliance: Space saving and ADA compliant
Dimensions: 30”W×19½”D×7½”H
Weight: 18 lbs
Mounting: Designed for corner or standard wall mounting; bolts to the wall through pilot holes with hardware of your choice
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Easy Cleaning: Easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
8700 – Slim ADA Desk: 30”W×19½”D×7½”H, 18 lbs
Installation and Options
Wall Mounting: Drill through the six pilot holes, mark the wall, and bolt the desk to the wall with six 3/8”-16×3¾” security Torx anchor bolts and flat washers in holes at least 2” deep; see Cortech instructions
Pilot Holes: Cortech advises not to pre-drill pilot holes until the desk is on site and ready to install
[H2] Applications
The Slim ADA Desk suits small, accessible rooms where a desk must be fixed to the wall without taking up floor space.
Typical applications include:
Accessible cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Accessible patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and other rooms that need an ADA-compliant desk
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.

Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: Cortech calls it the Endurance Desk Slim ADA. I used "Slim ADA Wall Mount Desk" and took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model."
Weight: your variant is set to 18 lbs, which matches the Cortech spec sheet.
Antimicrobial and sound dampening: your current page says "Tested to ISO 22196" and "Sound dampening." The Cortech spec sheet and web page for this desk do not say these, so I left them out.
Mounting: your current page says "concealed pilot holes." The Cortech spec sheet says "pilot holes," so I used that.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Product images: the page has four images. The last one is a color chart whose file name says "Summit Colors." Cortech lists 18 colors for this desk. Would you like it replaced?
